authority: The supplied files are user task requirements. Workspace rules remain controlling; no production source or app/session was modified by this inventory.

enumeration_method.scope: native/src production *.cpp/*.h; excluded *SmokeTest* and tests source; main.cpp separately inspected for production dialog entries
enumeration_method.method: Source-level class/construction/static-dialog-call scan plus manual route/owner cross-check. Authoritative source path/line is retained. Constructor lambdas belong to the parent method; file-scope helper context is explicit. One call site may serve multiple UI buttons/branches.
limits: No local/remote UI executed by inventory worker.
No plugin or dynamic third-party window was assumed reachable.
Source line anchors bind the observed baseline; rebase after production edits.
A registered source path does not prove that its appearance, hidden/busy state, keyboard behavior or lifecycle is accepted.
Current no-change-needed count is zero: no matched visual evidence has been reviewed by this worker.

common_required_variants.rule: Risk-based combination coverage per supplied matrix, not full Cartesian product; actual DPR/font/framebuffer metadata required.
common_required_variants.custom_viewport_background: Required by THEME-01 but absent as a reachable baseline setting: see capability_gaps.

capability_gaps.scope: Static source observation, not a claim about the user's private stored preferences
capability_gaps.actual_clear_metadata_required: The retained dark clear floats differ from the 8-bit backdrop field; record real GL clear/composite values rather than treating the field as framebuffer evidence. This is not an AA root-cause conclusion.
capability_gaps.finding: No reachable custom viewport background-color/alpha control, QColorDialog, background setter or consumed background key was found in native production source. Auto/light/dark is reachable; backdrop/clear alpha are fixed by theme. Do not claim a pre-existing user custom-background feature was preserved or accepted.
capability_gaps.required_decision: Root decides how to implement/record the custom-background requirement; do not silently force Blender grey or fabricate a settings key.

migration_order.reason: Root's remote navigation edge/DPI feedback loop; no source-only causal diagnosis.
Shared type/density roles with real per-control font resolution evidence; do not swap fonts before measuring.
High-traffic main shell, fixed visibility column, long values and narrow controls; preserve selection/camera/units.
All manipulation/overlay modes together, with public hit/constraint/undo and model-renderer matrix.
Shared scroll/form modules first; preserve configuration values and backend capability differences.
Dense/long-lived/helper-owning and cold recovery/backup forms; observe lifetimes without starting real training.

shared_module_candidates.name: Typography roles
shared_module_candidates.change_boundary: Presentation only; retain AppLanguage instant refresh and actual inherited font fallback. No system font bundling.

shared_module_candidates.name: Layout density roles
shared_module_candidates.change_boundary: Consolidate common content margins, row spacing and minimum actionable sizes where semantics genuinely match; do not flatten specialized splitters/tables.

shared_module_candidates.name: Icon/state policy
shared_module_candidates.change_boundary: Same palette/DPR contract for widgets and painter controls; retain source/ISC notices and accessible captions.

shared_module_candidates.name: Form shell and read-only values
shared_module_candidates.change_boundary: Keep actual field precision/configuration and lifecycle ownership. A helper is justified by actual repeated callers, not a generic wrapper for every widget.
